newsitem.title: CHINA: China orders recall of firm's unauthorised shares.
newsitem.headline: China orders recall of firm's unauthorised shares.

text.p: Authorities in China's southwestern Sichuan province have ordered Yuyong Power Co to recall shares it issued without authorisation, officials said on Tuesday.

The electric power company in Chongqing city in Sichuan province was set up through private share placements in 1990, an official with Chongqing Securities Management Office told Reuters by telephone.
The company issued 14.8 million shares in 1993 without approval and traded them through an automated trading system in Zibo in China's eastern Shandong province, the official said.
Asked why it took so long to act on the unauthorised share issue, the official said: "We only discovered the irregularities this year."
He added that the case was still being investigated and further penalties were possible.
